items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’d go hear Peterson, Martha Argerich, some of those Russian pianists play.

ctx.x: Have a chalet in Switzerland? Who would you like to listen to while you’re travelling? Is there any musician that you would especially like to drop in on?
I’d go hear Peterson, Martha Argerich, some of those Russian pianists play. I like to be real sharp, though. And then I like to go to Vegas.
Who would you like to listen to in Vegas?
